Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite for Widow's Bay.
The left half of a theatre travelling curtain seen square-on: deep crimson velvet hanging in heavy vertical folds from the top edge to the bottom edge, a gold bullion fringe along the bottom and down the right-hand leading edge, the folds a little bunched toward the left. Full height, no tie-back, no rail. Match the painted drapes of proscenium exactly in colour and fold style; the game mirrors it for the right panel. Requested final aspect ratio 1300:1440. Real transparent alpha outside the isolated art.
Input image is a style/palette reference; follow the written subject and geometry rather than reproducing unwanted elements.
No text or watermark.
